DoneClaim.title: Define PostgreSQL models, repositories, catalog migration, and database Compose service
DoneClaim.result: Implemented typed SQLAlchemy models and repositories, an async Alembic initial migration with the exact catalog seed, a PostgreSQL 18 Compose service, and PostgreSQL integration tests.
